description: This file defines a Dart class 'AuthApi' providing client methods to interact with FastAPI authentication endpoints, including login, signup, OTP verification, token refresh, and password reset, along with an exception class for handling API errors.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class to encapsulate API error messages and status codes.

classes.name: AuthApi
classes.description: API client class for authentication endpoints, with configurable base URL and methods for login, signup, OTP handling, token refresh, and password resets.

methods.name: _postJson
methods.description: Internal helper method to send POST requests with JSON payload and handle responses, throwing 'ApiException' on error.

methods.name: loginWithPassword
methods.description: Endpoint call for user login with password, returning user info or tokens.

methods.name: requestOtp
methods.description: Request an OTP to be sent to a phone number for login/signup.

methods.name: verifyOtp
methods.description: Verify an OTP received by the user for authentication.

methods.name: signupWithPassword
methods.description: Register a new user with phone, optional email, password, optional name, and consent acceptance.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Request to refresh authentication tokens using a refresh token.

methods.name: passwordResetRequest
methods.description: Initiate password reset process via email or phone.

methods.name: passwordResetConfirm
methods.description: Confirm password reset with OTP and new password.
